svg.title: Boole, Bonsai, and Qwen3: ten-task benchmark comparison
svg.desc: Two rows of five bar charts compare Boole-1.7B, Bonsai-1.7B, Ternary-Bonsai-1.7B, Bonsai-4B Q1_0 GGUF, and Qwen3-1.7B BF16. Logos appear inside every bar; model names are below the bars and evaluation names below each chart. Math, code, and tool-calling benchmarks are in the first row; reasoning and instruction-following benchmarks are in the second row. Every panel uses a zero-to-100 percent scale and the same model order. Exact recorded values are stored in the metadata and shown in each bar title.
svg.text: Non-thinking mode · Scores (%) · Higher is better
Quantization: Boole / Bonsai-1.7B: 1-bit · Ternary-Bonsai-1.7B: 2-bit packed (2.13 BPW) · Bonsai-4B: Q1_0 GGUF · Qwen3-1.7B: BF16.
Code: pass@1. IFEval / IFBench: mean strict prompt and instruction accuracy. BFCLv3: average of 13 single-turn subsets.
EvalScope 1.4.2 · bfcl-eval 2025.10.27.1 · GPQA-Diamond: ten sampled runs.
